This video is a good version of the taxi footage. If you listen closely to the gunfire in the first 1m30s or so, the gunfire is consistent with a single shooter firing from two locations. The sounds you hear have one of two sound characteristics and the time in between hearing one vs. the other (~15s) would be sufficient for a single gunman to move between the two broken windows (see representative room layout below.)

The shots are either loud with echo, or softer without echo. The loud shots with echo are consistent with shots fired from north-most window (the right window in pictures showing both), which would be above the taxi driver at that point in the video, and could echo off of the Luxor Hotel, Delano Hotel, or the shorter structures near the taxi driver. The softer shots would be consistent with shots fired from the east-facing window (the left window in pictures showing both), which would be around the corner of the building from the driver at that point in the video. (Is it possible that the taxi driver's phone may be performing some noise cancellation further muffling the distant sound?)

Regarding the flashing light on the fourth floor that some sources are citing as evidence of a second gunman, this taxi footage also captures that around 4:58.
